summary: iOS SDK background-suspend -> SSE rehandshake produces duplicate opening sentence and leaves markdown codeblock unclosed on resume
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that when their iOS app is backgrounded and later resumed, SSE streaming resumes but the returned stream contains a duplicated opening sentence and an unclosed Markdown codeblock (triple-backtick). Impact: renders assistant output unusable for downstream rendering (NoteStream shows hanging codeblocks and repeated leading text). Environment: production, SDK iOS v1.4.2, mobile carriers and wifi observed in us-west region.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Start a streaming chat via iOS SDK (v1.4.2) using SSE transport to redwood endpoint in us-west.
2) Allow stream to produce a partial response that includes a codeblock (```js).
3) Background the app (iOS suspend) for ~30s.
4) Bring app to foreground and allow SDK to resume connection/handshake.

Observed behavior: On resume the client receives a replayed opening sentence at the top of the resumed chunk (duplicate of earlier prefix) and the final codeblock fence is missing on the stream end, leaving markdown unclosed. In some sessions the server emits the final end-event, but the SDK's recomposition appears to drop the trailing backticks.

Expected behavior: Resume should continue from the last emitted token without re-emitting already-received tokens; final markdown fences should be preserved so output parses as valid markdown.

Recent changes: Customer updated to SDK 1.4.2 last week; server-side recent change was an idle-keepalive tweak rolled 2026-03-08 (serving-runtime heartbeat window tightening).

Logs / sample traces: Customer attached SDK logs showing session id and resume handshake. Key excerpt: 
[2026-03-10T15:12:02Z] SSE:onmessage {chunkId: "c-7f3a", text: "Here is a helper function...
```js
function add(a, b) {"}
[2026-03-10T15:12:34Z] App:backgrounding
[2026-03-10T15:13:04Z] SDK:reconnect attempt
[2026-03-10T15:13:05Z] SSE:onmessage {chunkId: "c-7f3a-resume", text: "Here is a helper function...
```js
function add(a, b) {
```"}
(Notice duplicate opening sentence and missing closing fence in the first message before a subsequent small patch message closes fence intermittently.)

Temporary workaround: Customer downgraded to SDK v1.3.8 and reports no duplication in their tests. Workaround also: avoid backgrounding during active streaming sessions or add client-side post-processing to dedupe repeated prefix and append closing fence when missing.

Customer impact: NoteStream has ~120 active users hitting this flow daily; rendering bug blocks note previews and causes UX regressions.

Investigation notes (engineer):
- Initial hypothesis: session resume logic in SDK treats resume as a fresh partial and replays buffered prefix rather than deduplicating overlap.
- Alternative hypothesis: serving-runtime keepalive/heartbeat change shortened idle window causing the client to reattach to a slightly different resume offset, resulting in server re-sending range that overlaps.
- Repro attempt on prod-us-west with internal test client reproduced duplicate prefix when using iOS SDK v1.4.2 and iOS suspend; reproduction rate ~40%.
- Server logs for session show resume requests with range header window [tokens 0..N] instead of [N+1..]. Need to correlate token offsets across client/server.
- No evidence of proxy tampering; connection observed to reestablish directly to edge instance.

Next steps:
1) Engineering to add additional debug logging on resume offset negotiation in serving-runtime (trace token-offsets) and coordinate with SDK team to log client-side last-received-offset before reconnect. (Assigned to @Ethan Liu)
2) SDK team to audit v1.4.2 resume assembly path and dedupe logic; consider backporting v1.3.8 resume behavior if regression confirmed. (Assigned to SDK)
3) Provision a canary with extended resume-window tolerance on one us-west edge to validate server-side mitigation.

Resolution plan: TBD — awaiting SDK hotfix or server resume-offset clamp.

References: Slack thread #support-note-stream (https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C02SUP123), test run log: s3://redwood-support/sup-424242/traces.log
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Patel (Support) - Logged initial report and requested full SDK logs and reproducer steps. Noted customer downgraded to v1.3.8 as temporary validation.
2026-03-10 Customer (NoteStream Labs) - Provided SDK log bundle and short screen capture showing markdown rendering freeze in app. Reports repro only on iOS, not Android.
2026-03-11 Ethan Liu (Eng) - Reproduced locally with iOS simulator and SDK v1.4.2 using a background/foreground script. Observed the duplicated prefix. Created internal trace request: TRACE-98132.

2026-03-11 Jane K. (SDK Lead) - Investigating resume assembly path; suspect race where client buffers suffix and on reconnect both client and server replay overlapping token windows. Preparing patch to dedupe on assembly.

2026-03-12 Ethan Liu (Eng) - Correlated server token-offsets; server accepted resume-range starting from 0 for ~12% of resumed sessions in last 48h (likely tied to heartbeat change). Raising a serving-runtime change to clamp resume ranges.
resolution: Pending - engineering patch planned. SDK team to release v1.4.3 with dedupe-on-resume; server will also apply a resume-range-clamp canary in us-west. Customer workaround: continue using v1.3.8 or avoid backgrounding during active streams.
